author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Dual-Screen GBA is Now a Thing
summary: Retro Game Corps demonstrates a new emulator that converts single-screen Game Boy Advance titles into dual-screen experiences with quality-of-life improvements.

blocks.text: The video explores a new emulator application hosted on GitHub that reimagines standard Game Boy Advance games by rendering them across two screens. The presenter walks through installation and setup procedures, then tests multiple titles to show how the dual-screen layout functions in practice. The project aims to add quality-of-life enhancements while preserving the original gameplay experience on compatible handheld devices.

Viewers interested in modified GBA experiences on dual-screen hardware may find the walkthrough useful for evaluating compatibility and setup steps. Results will vary depending on the specific device, firmware version, and configuration choices. The creator's observations reflect personal testing and are not independently verified by this publication. Users should only employ legally obtained BIOS files and game images when experimenting with this software.
